inputs.original_text: Listen to this: earlier this month an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law by arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim came from the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, who said the law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” This is no genuine religious stand. It is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions twisting religion into a weapon to protect the killing of babies and advance their control agenda. They are inverting the truth, using so-called freedom as cover while suppressing any real protection for life. Do not trust the surface story for a moment.
inputs.modified_text: You won't believe what they're pulling now—earlier this month an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law by claiming limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice pushed this line, saying the law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” This isn't any authentic religious position. It's all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions twisting religion into a weapon to shield the killing of babies and push their control agenda. They're straight-up inverting the truth, hiding behind so-called freedom while stamping out real protections for life. Don't trust the surface story for a second.
